programme.title: On the Case: Last Call
programme.desc: When bartender Anita Andrews is stabbed to death inside her family's bar, police conclude her killer was the last patron she served that night.

programme.title: On the Case: Unfinished Journey
programme.desc: Jamie Bowie disappears while driving from Phoenix to Los Angeles on Interstate 10, then her body is found near the highway a month later.

programme.title: On the Case: Golden Promises Broken
programme.desc: High school sweethearts disappear during a picnic and investigators spend years chasing false leads.

programme.title: On the Case: A Face with No Name
programme.desc: Police have DNA evidence and a videotape of their suspect, yet they still struggle to find a vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Dreams and Nightmares
programme.desc: An 18-year-old woman is murdered the night before her college career is about to begin.

programme.title: On the Case: Deep Wounds
programme.desc: After Navy electrician Michael Jacobs comes home to find his wife, Suzanne, and his three-year-old son, Colin, murdered, San Diego police race to catch a serial killer who leaves behind an unimaginable calling card.

programme.title: On the Case: Twisted Lies
programme.desc: In Las Vegas, 41-year-old Nancy Menke, a mother of four, is found handcuffed and murdered in the passenger seat of her car; a records clerk in the insurance fraud unit stumbles upon a strange report that blows open Menke's murder case.

programme.title: On the Case: Fatal Turn
programme.desc: A devoted mother vanishes on her way home from work. Her disappearance sends police into the darkest corners of the state and our justice system.

programme.title: On the Case: No Exit
programme.desc: A young couple, out on the town in Washington D.C., is gunned down in a savage attack. Investigators are at a loss. Would it take another murder to solve the mystery?

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in the Sun
programme.desc: When Kenny Baker returns home, the backdoor is ajar and his wife, Kathy, and two-year-old son, Ryan, are nowhere to be found.

programme.title: On the Case: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: A young mother is murdered in broad daylight with her toddler just a few feet away. Police have little to go on except the bizarre description eyewitnesses have given them of the brazen killer.

programme.title: On the Case: In Plain Sight
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman is murdered the evidence points detectives to a killer hiding in plain sight.

programme.title: On the Case: River of Tears
programme.desc: Paula examines the discovery of a young woman's lifeless body on the bank of a shallow river. A note in her pocket may point to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Last Rites
programme.desc: When a nun is found strangled and stabbed to death on the day before Easter, investigators are forced to look behind church walls in search of a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Carnage
programme.desc: When 25 year old Laci Hill vanishes without a trace; police receive the key to solving the mystery from her kidnapper's wife.

programme.title: On the Case: Unmistakable Truth
programme.desc: A family of three is murdered and investigators must take on one of their own in order to find justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Signed In Blood
programme.desc: In order to solve the vicious double murder of a beloved couple, police must uncover a cold blooded killer's carefully calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: Shortcut to Murder
programme.desc: Paula Zahn goes beyond the headlines in search of fascinating mysteries from within America's justice system. A shortcut home from school causes a 14-year-old girl to cross paths with a murderer.

programme.title: On the Case: Footsteps in the Dark
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman's is murdered in a dark parking lot. Did she know her killer or was she the victim of a deadly predator?

programme.title: On the Case: The Ultimate Sin
programme.desc: A man's crisis of conscience unravels a decades old mystery behind a young girl's murder.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: 40/40/40
programme.desc: Mechanic Cory races against the clock to turn two short-haul waterbombers into transatlantic aircraft for the epic journey to Turkey. It's up to engineer Adam to get the C-46 crew out of a jam on a remote airstrip in minus 40.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Duane lands a huge contract for the Electra and puts enormous pressure on mechanic Adam to prep the plane without the help of his mentor Chuck.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Chief Pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck goes one-on-one with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour with the newest member of the McBryan family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Buffalo Scores
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North. Cup fever spreads quickly around Buffalo, and for Mikey, what begins as an innocent love for this hockey icon soon becomes an obsession.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: On the Move
programme.desc: A charter flight falls through the cracks after the McBryans attend a wild family wedding, and an irate Joe pulls captain Justin from the Turkey test flights to do the job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: D-Day
programme.desc: Mikey's much-planned D-Day tribute parachute jump with 20 paratroopers hits a wall when Joe refuses to fly his DC-3 to the drop zone.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Change of Seasons
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go? Scott gets the news he must stand down from flying so another co-pilot can fast-track to captain.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under Pressure
programme.desc: The curse of -40 hits Buffalo pilots Devan and Scott on a food mail flight up the Mackenzie Valley when a mysterious rise in oil pressure threatens to destroy one of the C-46's engines.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Plans, Bad Luck
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day. Prefkar escapes Hay River courier duty. Cory finds an original bracket for the DC3 static line for Mikey's D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cause for Celebration
programme.desc: AJ and Candace get married in the Ice Castle. A frustrated Chuck tries to get the Electra to pay her way. A flummoxed Mikey tries to bake a cake for Joe's birthday.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: A Sisterly Christmas
programme.desc: To søstre må lægge deres uenigheder til side for at vinde den årlige konkurrence på et lokalt feriested inden juledag.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Switch
programme.desc: For at flygte fra deres problemet beslutter de enæggede tvillinger Bianca, en singlekvinde med en nærig chef, og Kaelynn, en enlig mor til to børn, sig for at bytte plads over julen.

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: Da to svindlere mødes efter at have crashet den samme millionærs julefrokost, bliver de enige om at samarbejde – uvidende om, at de snart finder noget, der er vigtigere end rigdom og berømmelse: ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: Juleenglen
programme.desc: Den gode samaritaner Sarah Fitzpatrick er ude for en dødsulykke lige inden jul, og befinder sig pludselig i lobbyen ved porten til Himlen. Hun er sikker på at blive lukket ind, og bliver chokeret, da hun finder ud af at hendes navn ikke er på listen.

programme.title: Under the Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Alma Beltran skal overtage sin families 100 år gamle virksomhed, men Alma er en stædig traditionalist, der helst ikke vil have råd fra den virksomhedskonsulent, som hendes forældre har hyret.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunaldirektør får hjælp af sin barndomsven til at arrangere byens julevelgørenhedsarrangement, og samtidigt forsøger hun at splejse ham sammen med sin nære veninde.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: Beckys juleønske er, at hendes familie for én gangs skyld vil høre på hende. Men så begynder alle hendes tanker og frustrationer at vælte ud, da hun ufrivilligt begynder at fortælle alle, hvad hun virkelig tænker.

programme.title: A Christmas Star
programme.desc: En astronom forudsiger, at der vil forekomme en ny meteorregn over en lille by, men hun må overtale de lokale til at hjælpe til med forberedelserne til sin opdagelse på bekostning af en juletradition.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: Charlotte ender i koma efter en ulykke, men hendes sjæl er vågen. Inden en afstemning om et ejendomsprojekt skal hun få sin by og bygherren til at skifte mening, mens ingen kan se eller høre hende.

programme.title: Much Ado About Christmas
programme.desc: Efter at Haley er blevet såret af utallige bejlere, falder Claud for hende uden at kende hendes sande identitet. Men da denne sandhed uundgåeligt kommer frem, bringer det romancen i fare.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.

programme.title: NCIS: Fysisk afstraffelse
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet betaler en høj pris, da de forsøger at finde en marinesoldat, som menes stadig at befinde sig i Irak.

programme.title: NCIS: Stammer
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker en sag om en muslimsk marinesoldat, som findes død nær en moské, der mistænkes for at rekruttere terrorister.

programme.title: NCIS: Overvågning
programme.desc: Da en avanceret flåderadar forsvinder, overvåger NCIS-teamet en lagerbygning for at fange en mistænkt tyv, men de bevidner et mord i stedet.

programme.title: NCIS: Hundetegn
programme.desc: Da NCIS-teamet efterforsker et offer, der blev flænset til døde af en hund, sætter Abby sin karriere på spil for at bevise hundens uskyld og redde hans liv.

programme.title: NCIS: Interne affærer
programme.desc: Da liget af våbenhandleren La Grenouille dukker op, efterforsker FBI NCIS-teamet for mordet på ham, og Jenny Shepard bliver den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: NCIS: I krigszonen
programme.desc: Da et morterangreb i Bagdad ender som en mordefterforskning, sendes to medlemmer af NCIS-teamet til Irak for at opklare sagen.

programme.title: NCIS: Rekyl
programme.desc: Zivas undercoveropgave tager en chokerende og dødelig drejning, da en seriemorder, hun har sporet, mistænker hende.

programme.title: NCIS: Genkendt
programme.desc: Jimmy Palmer bliver mål for en mystisk morder, som kun han kan genkende.

programme.title: NCIS: Dommedag, Del I
programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.title: NCIS: Dommedag, Del II
programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.title: NCIS: Dobbeltgænger
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet undersøger det mulige mord på en underofficer, der blev rapporteret af en telefonsælger, som hørte det over telefonen.

programme.title: NCIS: Vidne
programme.desc: Gibbs giver McGee et forsøg på at køre en sag, da NCIS-teamet bliver tilkaldt for at efterforske en kvinde (Danica McKellar) som hævder at have været vidne til mordet på en sømand.

programme.title: NCIS: Optaget På Video
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker, da en marinesoldat optager sit eget mord på video, når han falder ud over en klippe. Gibbs og teamet tilkaldes, da marinesoldaten findes død under en campingtur med sin kone og bedste ven, der havde en affære.

programme.title: NCIS: Popliv
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker det bizarre dødsfald af en kvindelig underofficer, som brutalt er blevet myrdet i sengen hos en bartender på en danseklub.

programme.title: NCIS: Et Øje For Et Øje
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker, da et par blå øjne sendes til en sømand i D.C. i en pakke fra Paraguay.

programme.title: NCIS: Bikinivoks
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker, da en underofficer der for nylig vendte tilbage fra tjeneste, bliver fundet død bag scenen til en lokal bikinikonkurrence.

programme.title: NCIS: Sammensværgelsesteori
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet efterforsker, da en underofficer begår selvmord, efter at være blevet indlagt med et nervøst sammenbrud.

programme.title: NCIS: Rødt Felt
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet går tilbage til skolen, da en marinesoldat i et reserveofficersuddannelsesprogram findes myrdet på et universitetsområde.

programme.title: NCIS: Hjembyshelt
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet arbejder på at rense navnet på en flådelæge, der er dræbt i Irak, og som er den primære mistænkte for et mord i sin hjemby.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling LVI
programme.desc: I et nyt afsnit af Ridiculousness fejrer Rob, Chanel og Steelo ældre mennesker i 'Den mest liderlige generation', tjekker nogle børn ud, der ville have det 'Bedre uden forældre' og ser, hvordan man giver 'Ekstra 10 procent'.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Amber og Gary løser omsider deres myndighedstvist om Leah. Farrah planlægger at flytte til LA, men er usikker på sit forhold til Simon. Catelynn og Tyler overvejer at få et barn mere, og mødrene rejser til LA.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Farrahs mor konfronterer Simon til Sophias 7-års fødselsdag. Amber håndterer det seneste medierygte om Matt. Catelynns depression kommer tilbage, og hun søger hjælp hos dr. Drew.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Maci og Taylor opdager, at den uventede graviditet er mere fremskreden, end de troede. Matt tager Amber med til sin hjemby, hvor hun møder hans familiemedlemmer.

programme.title: The Hills: Out With The Old
programme.desc: Efter en svær sommer med sin fyr Jason, beslutter Lauren at slå op og venter tilbage til Teen Vogue for at møde sin utilfredse chef. Heidi får problemer med en fyr, som både hun og Audrina dater.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It
programme.desc: Lauren tager på sin første date efter Jason og bliver sat på prøve, da hun bliver bedt om at arbejde til en modeopvisning. Heidi har en livsforandrende hemmelighed, som hun må fortælle sin fyr.

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: Da en ikke inviteret Audrina dukker op til Heidis fødselsdag, finder hun ud af, at Heidi ikke er parat til at tilgive og glemme. Lauren vil fokusere på sit arbejde, men falder for den charmerende nye fyr i sit liv, Brody.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Før hun fandt ud af, at hun var gravid, var Maci en superelev fra Chattanooga, Tenessee. Da hendes kæreste Ryan ikke viser nogen interesse for at hjælpe, skal Maci finde ud af, om deres forhold kan overleve.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Farrah er en populær leder af heppekoret fra Council Bluffs i Iowa, men da hendes venner begynder at sladre om, at hun skal være alenemor, opgiver hun interessen for high school og begynder at tilbringe alt for meget tid med sin kommanderende mor.

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Amber er en partypige fra Anderson, Indiana. Hun havde aldrig forestillet sig, at hun skulle tilbringe sit sidste skoleår med at flytte ind hos sin velmenende, men umodne kæreste Gary.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Tanned Triangle
programme.desc: Snooki mener stadigvæk at alle hader hende, så hun beslutter sig for at forlade Jersey Shore. På den første bytur går vores nye kammerater i serien til den, så kæresterne derhjemme får en del at bekymre sig om.

programme.desc: Kærligheds-trekanten bliver endnu mere intens da Ronnie fanger Sammy i at give sit nummer til en helt fjerde fyr. En af deltagerne vælger at forlade Jersey Shore for altid.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Catch Her If You Can
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Drawn to Murder - Part 1
programme.desc: A two-part report on the February 1987 murder of 37-year-old Peggy Hettrick in Fort Collins, Colorado. Her mutilated, half-naked body was discovered in a field near the home of Tim Masters, a 15-year-old who lived near the crime scene.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Drawn to Murder - Part 2
programme.desc: A two-part report on the February 1987 murder of 37-year-old Peggy Hettrick in Fort Collins, Colorado. Her mutilated, half-naked body was discovered in a field near the home of Tim Masters, a 15-year-old who lived near the crime scene.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Grave Injustice
programme.desc: A report on the case of Anthony Graves, who spent eighteen years -- twelve of them on death row -- in a Texas prison for murders he did not commit.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Arturo Gatti's Last Fight
programme.desc: A report on the mysterious 2009 death of world champion boxer Arturo Gatti. When Gatti was found dead in Brazil, police characterized the death as a homicide and arrested his wife.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report about how female Los Angeles Police Detective Stephanie Lazarus was charged with the 1986 murder of Sherri Mae Rasmussen. The victim, newly married to Lazarus’ ex-boyfriend, was attacked, beaten and shot to death in her Los Angeles home.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets of a Marriage
programme.desc: A report on questions surrounding the apparent suicide of Jocelyn Earnest, a successful businesswoman who was found dead in her home in December 2007, from a gunshot wound to her head, with a revolver by her side and a suicide note on the floor.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Facebook Detectives
programme.desc: A report about three Texas housewives, Tammye Markle, Joni Shannon, and Tina Wiley, who call themselves the "Facebook Detectives" and who used the Internet to try to find their friend Lisa Stone, who disappeared from her Dallas home in June 2010.

programme.title: 48 Hours: House of Secrets
programme.desc: In September 2006, Kathy Wangler, wife of anesthesiologist Dr. Mark Wangler, died from carbon monoxide poisoning in their home. Their 30-year marriage had been falling apart; In 2009, investigators concluded that Dr. Wangler had murdered his wife.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder at the Manor
programme.desc: A report about Harold Landry, a self-made millionaire who left behind his life in Louisiana to pursue a romance with a British woman he met online, and how this seemingly perfect relationship ended when Lucy Landry was murdered at their home in 2010.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Shelley's Last Breath
programme.desc: An investigation into the 1999 scuba diving death of Shelley Tyre while on vacation on the Caribbean isle of Tortola. Police questioned her husband and dive partner David Swain about every detail of the dive; autopsy results were inconclusive.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Soccer Moms Confidential
programme.desc: A report on the investigation of ex-cop turned private eye Chris Butler who staffed his San Francisco Bay area firm with local soccer moms to solve cases.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Mystery on Twin Peaks Drive
programme.desc: A report on the December 16, 1998 death of Ronda Reynolds, whose husband found her lifeless body with a gunshot wound to the head in her home on Twin Peaks Drive in Toledo, Washington.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Stranger Beside Me
programme.desc: In 2010, Jamie Laiaddee vanished from her home in a suburb of Phoenix. Her boyfriend Bryan Stewart told everyone she had moved to Colorado to take a new job. When detectives started searching for Jamie, they discovered Bryan was a con man.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Ransom
programme.desc: A report on the mysterious 2008 disappearance of Robert Wiles, the son of millionaire business owner Tom Wiles, who received an e-mail ransom note demanding $750,000 for the safe return of the 26-year-old.

programme.title: 48 Hours: An Officer and a Hero
programme.desc: On how a firefighter, with the help of his girlfriend, an unarmed police officer, survived a brutal home invasion.

programme.title: Like Crazy

programme.title: Mellem 2 Kvinder

programme.title: Sommersby

programme.title: Love's Last Resort

programme.title: Then Came You

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up

programme.title: P.S.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sportsjakker

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader falsk id

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader egnethedsprøver
programme.desc: Chris ved, at han skal have høje point for at blive optaget på college og beslutter sig for at terpe til sin PSAT-prøve. Da Rochelle tvinger familien ud til et arrangement, har Chris ikke tid til at læse og vælger at købe svarene til prøven.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader boksning

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader lasagne
programme.desc: Chris går modvilligt med til at opbevare noget pot for en forbryder på flugt, men han har svært ved at finde et gemmested, der ikke får ham i knibe.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader bilen
programme.desc: Da Chris får sit kørekort, giver Rochelle og Julius ham lov til at købe en bil, men da bilen bliver stjålet og vandaliseret, indser Chris, hvor stort et ansvar det er at eje en bil.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader flabethed

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Tasha

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksamen

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Keisha

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader basketball

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader pølse
programme.desc: Da Julius køber en stor kasse pølser, tvinger han alle til at spise det til alle måltider. Men det nægter Tonya, og det skaber spændinger mellem hende og Rochelle.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Fede Mike
programme.desc: Chris lader et af børnene fra nabolaget låne sin cykel, selv om Julius advarer ham mod det, og drengen stjæler den.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader halloween

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader babysitteren

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader jul

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader deltidsarbejde

programme.desc: Jakob Kjeldbjerg åbner Robinson Ekspeditionen med kompromisløs autoritet, når deltagerne fra start skal træffe svære fravalg af hinanden inden den første holdkonkurrence.

programme.desc: Efter blot få dage på stranden skal det tabende hold i Dysten beslutte, hvem der bliver den første til at forlade Robinson Ekspeditionen 2026.

programme.desc: Overleverne skal endnu engang træffe svære fravalg, når en fra hvert hold sendes til Forhandling. Forhandlingen får store konsekvenser for to af Ekspeditionens deltagere.

programme.desc: I Striden kæmper holdene om en lækker frugtkurv. Men sejrens sødme overskygges af dramatiske hændelser, der får stor betydning for flere af ekspeditionens overlevere.

programme.desc: Med blot 4 overlevere tilbage på Hold Syd, ryster Jakob Kjeldbjerg posen, når de to hold kæmper om en hemmelighedsfuld kiste. Kisten får store konsekvenser for både Nord- og Sydboerne.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen falder til jorden med et brag. Eksperterne kommer på ekstraarbejde, før det – forhåbentlig – ender med, at den lille familie flytter ind i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to børn har overtaget hjemmet, og der er legetøj overalt. Løsningen er en større bolig, men det er ikke lykkedes parret at finde det rigtige hus. Nu går eksperterne i gang, men det bliver ikke nemt.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en smuk herskabslejlighed på Frederiksberg med deres to børn. Men de ønsker sig mere plads i et børnevenligt kvarter i cykelafstand til indre by. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finde et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 506
programme.desc: En lille lejebolig i Vanløse og to små børn – det er ikke det bedste match. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med stor have. Tobias kommer på hårdt arbejde, for drømmene er en hel del større end budgettet.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 601
programme.desc: Nathja, Kristian og deres nyfødte datter bor i en ombygget butik med en faldstamme i soveværelset. Kristian drømmer om en kæmpe garage, og Nathja vil helst blive i Køge – kan Tobias opfylde deres drømme?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 602
programme.desc: Maja og Kenneth bor i Vestjylland og drømmer om at komme tættere på Majas familie i Silkeborg. Men deres budget kræver, at de går på kompromis med beliggenheden og kigger i de nærliggende småbyer.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 603
programme.desc: I Ikast hungrer Camilla og Marc efter et hus med plads til opbevaring. Men da Tobias finder dem et stort hus, tager det helt modet fra parret, at der nu er SÅ mange rum, der skal istandsættes...

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 604
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel sukker efter mere plads, inden de snart udvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt, da Mads ringer og fortæller dem, at handlen med deres nye hus i Langå er faldet.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 605
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel sukker efter mere plads, inden de snart udvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt, da Mads ringer og fortæller dem, at handlen med deres nye hus i Langå er faldet.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 701
programme.desc: Cecilie og Kristoffer bor med deres lille søn i en træt lejlighed i Århus, men drømmer om plads og ro. Men hvor rolig bliver man, når man pludselig ejer et hus, man slet ikke føler sig hjemme i?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 702

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 703

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland

programme.desc: Deputies confront an intoxicated man who threatened a restaurant owner. A man tells officers he can assault who he wants. Officers are called to an altercation over a sleeping bag and a backpack.

programme.desc: Officers pursue an SUV on the freeway. Deputies are called when an agitated man armed with scissors tears up a trailer. A driver tells officers the illegal items found in his car was left by a friend.

programme.title: COPS: Hide and Go Porch
programme.desc: Officers engage in a car chase when they spot a possible robbery suspect. A man nicknamed "Danger" is tasered after assaulting several girls. Suspects bail from a vehicle and hide under a porch.

programme.title: COPS: Pub Rules
programme.desc: A prostitution sting leads police to uncover additional crimes . A prostitute tells deputies she wanted money to buy her daughter a birthday gift. Deputies are called to an assault at a pub.

programme.title: COPS: Alleycat
programme.desc: Officers search for a runaway suspect with a weapons charge. A man admits to having a large number of drugs during a traffic stop. Officers respond to a man with a gun in an alley.

programme.title: COPS: Victoria's New Secret
programme.desc: Deputies observe a woman stuff drugs into her bra. A mother attacks her daughter because she got married in Vegas. Officers are called when a woman is accused of stalking her friend.

programme.title: COPS: Apologies Detective
programme.desc: Officers hold a man under a car at gunpoint after a traffic stop. Officers are flagged down and directed to an arguing couple. A man apologizes to detectives for the illicit items they find.

programme.title: Frasier: The Dinner Party
programme.desc: Frasiers planer om et elegant middagsselskab render ind i den ene forhindring efter den anden.

programme.title: Frasier: Taps at the Montana
programme.desc: Niles, der står over for at blive sat ud af sin snobbede lejerbestyrelse, laver en fest for at vinde deres gunst igen.

programme.title: Frasier: IQ
programme.desc: Søskenderivaliseringen mellem Frasier og Niles når nye højder, da de sammenligner IQ-point.

programme.title: Frasier: Dr. Nora
programme.desc: Frasier er skrækslagen, da en mildt talende kvindelig psykolog, han nødede stationen til at ansætte, viser sig at være en skrapt talende tyran.

programme.title: Frasier: When a Man Loves Two Women
programme.desc: Frasiers er spillet mellem at date sin gamle kæreste eller en frodig ny flamme.
programme.sub-title: When a Man Loves Two Women

programme.title: Frasier: Visions of Daphne
programme.desc: Til Niles store fornøjelse giver en serie synske åbenbaringer Daphne betænkeligheder omkring at gifte sig med Donny.

programme.title: Frasier: Shutout in Seattle (Part 1)
programme.desc: Niles, der er nedtrykt over Daphnes engagement, slår sig løs med en funky servitrice fra Café Nervosa.

programme.title: Frasier: Shutout in Seattle (Part 2)
programme.desc: Frasier, Martin, Nilesog Roz's kærlighedsliv falder sammen omkring dem.

programme.title: Frasier: The Good Son (Pilot)
programme.desc: Psykiateren Frasier Crane vender tilbage til sin fødeby Seattle for at være vært på et radiotalkshow, men opdager snart, at han selv har brug for en psykiater, da hans handicappede far flytter ind.

programme.title: Frasier: Space Quest
programme.desc: Frasier er træt af manglen på privatliv både derhjemme og på jobbet, beslutter det er tid til, at faderen flytter ud.

programme.title: Frasier: Dinner At Eight
programme.desc: Det er et kulturet kultursammenstød, da Frasier og Niles mødes med deres far til en middag på hans yndlingsrestaurant.

programme.title: Frasier: I Hate Frasier Crane
programme.desc: Efter at have udvekslet spydigheder med en avisskribent lader Frasier sig udfordre til at deltage i sin første slåskamp.

programme.title: Frasier: Here's Looking At You
programme.desc: Frasier leger Kirsten Giftekniv for sin far og den eftertragtede ungkarl Martin, og spionerer gennem sit teleskop.

programme.title: Frasier: The Crucible
programme.desc: Frasier konfronteres met et personligt og professionelt dilemma, da han begynder at date ekskæresten til en lytterne til hans radioprogram.

programme.title: Frasier: Call Me Irresponsible
programme.desc: Frasier konfronteres met et personligt og professionelt dilemma, da han begynder at date ekskæresten til en lytterne til hans radioprogram.

programme.title: Frasier: Beloved Infidel
programme.desc: Da Frasier og Niles ser deres far spise middag med en gammel ven af familien, konkluderer de, at Martin engang havde en affære med den kvinde.

programme.title: Frasier: Selling Out
programme.desc: Da Frasier lokkes ind i et live støtteprogram, kommer hans professionelle troværdighed under beskydning.

programme.title: Frasier: Oops
programme.desc: Da Frasier bidraget til rygtespredning, er han skyld i, at Bulldog mister sit job.

programme.title: Frasier: Death Becomes Him
programme.desc: Da en tilsyneladende sund kollega dør uventet, bliver Frasier besat af sin egen dødelighed.

programme.title: Frasier: Miracle On Third Or Fourth Street
programme.desc: Da sønnen ikke kan holde juleferie sammen med ham, lærer en melankolsk Frasier julens sande ånd at kende fra en gruppe fremmede.
programme.sub-title: Miracle On Third Or Fourth Street

programme.title: Frasier: Guess Who's Coming To Breakfast?
programme.desc: Martin bliver rasende på Frasier, da han afslører hemmelighederne i sin fars kærlighedsliv i radioprogrammet.

programme.title: Frasier: Can't Buy Me Love
programme.desc: Frasier glæder sig til en hot date med en smuk model, som 'købte' ham på en ungkarleauktion for berømtheder.

programme.title: Frasier: You Can't Tell A Crook By His Cover
programme.desc: Efter Frasier påstår at kunne udpege kriminelle i en menneskemængde, udfordrer Martin ham til at identificere eksfangen i sin pokergruppe.
programme.sub-title: You Can't Tell A Crook By His Cover

programme.title: Frasier: The Show Where Lilith Comes Back
programme.desc: Efter at have fundet et forsoningsbrev fra Frasier, der længe har været væk, kommer Lilith til Seattle og forsøger at genoptage deres forhold.
programme.sub-title: The Show Where Lilith Comes Back

programme.title: Frasier: A Midwinter Night's Dream
programme.desc: Niles står over for den ultimative fristelse, da Daphne er fanget i hans hjem under en voldsom storm.

programme.title: Frasier: And The Whimper Is
programme.desc: Da Frasiers program nomineres til en lokal radioprogrampris, foreslår Ro, at de 'overtaler' juryen ved at bearbejde dem med gaver.

programme.title: Frasier: Give Him The Chair
programme.desc: Frasier lærer, at følelser er vigtigere end stil, efter han ved et uheld mister sin fars gamle lænestol.

programme.title: Frasier: Fortysomething
programme.desc: I panik over at blive ældre, søger Frasier trøst i jagten på en køn ung kvinde, der viser sin interesse i ham.

programme.title: Frasier: Travels With Martin
programme.desc: Frasiers forsøg på at lave en far-søn-ferie bliver til en skrækkelig køretur, da Niles og Daphne tager med på turen.

programme.title: Frasier: Author Author
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles forsøger at arbejde sammen om at skrive en bog, men ender med at skændes mere end at skrive.

programme.title: Frasier: Frasier Crane's Day Off
programme.desc: Frasier er blevet ramt af influenza. Han bliver hjemme fra arbejde, men bliver mere og mere paranoid, fordi han tror, at alle, inklusive Niles, vil overtage hans radioprogram.

programme.title: Frasier: My Coffee With Niles
programme.desc: Da Niles spørger Frasier, om han er lykkelig efter hans første år tilbage i Seattle, åbner spørgsmålet op for en komisk og afslørende familiedialog.

programme.title: Frasier: Slow Tango In South Seattle
programme.desc: Frasier opdager, at en lummer bestseller var baseret på hans affære med en ældre kvinde.

programme.title: Frasier: The Unkindest Cut Of All
programme.desc: Efter Eddie bliver far til et kuld uægte hundehvalpe, går Frasier bag om ryggen på Martin for at få hunden kastreret.

programme.title: Frasier: Duke's, We Hardly Knew Ye
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles er ophidsede over at finde ud af, at deres investorer i firmaet planlagde at nedrive deres fars yndlingstilholdssted.

programme.title: Frasier: The Matchmaker
programme.desc: Frasiers plan om at 'parre' Daphne med sin nye chef går skævt, da Frasier hører om hans hemmelighed.

programme.title: Frasier: Flour Child
programme.desc: Efter at have set en kvinde føde, beslutter Niles, at det er på tide at øve sig i forældrefærdigheder - på en sæk mel!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: Efter en episk kamp mod borgene (cybernetisk forstærkede livsformer), følger kaptajn Picard og hans besætning borgene tilbage til 2000-tallet for at forhindre, at de ændrer jordens tidslinje og den første udenjordiske kontakt.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: Fra føderationens start var hovedreglen klar. Ingen Starfleet-ekspedition må forstyrre den naturlige udvikling af andre civilisationer. Men Picard konfronteres nu med ordrer, der går imod den regel.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Kursen er sat mod en galakse med action og eventyr uden lige, mens kaptajn Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) og hans stjerneskibsbesætning kæmper mod en farlig modstander, som har en overraskende forbindelse til Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)
programme.desc: Marina Ciampi, 52, is found dead at her home in Marseille. The victim is naked on her bed, a plastic bag over her head. But no trace of a break-in is detected.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Deadly Date On the Internet (Ciampi case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case
programme.desc: On March 28th 2013, the burnt body of Anne Barbot, 38 years old, is discovered in a forest of Maine-et-Loire.
programme.sub-title: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.
programme.sub-title: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.
programme.sub-title: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Priscillia Ciatti Case
programme.desc: The corpse of Priscillia Ciatti, 14, is discovered by the side of a field, a few hundred metres from her family home. The teenager has been stabbed sixty times with a knife and –an extra sordid detail – a devil mask is found next to her body.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Murder in Le Grand Bornand (Flactif case)
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear. For several days, mystery reigns.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murder in Le Grand Bornand (Flactif case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)
programme.desc: On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school
programme.sub-title: A Fatal Student Night (Stéphane Kameugne Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man. In order to identify this unknown man, whose face was unrecognizable.
programme.sub-title: The Key to the Enigma (Farid Ouzzane Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair
programme.desc: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.
programme.sub-title: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Willy Pomonti Case
programme.desc: Willy Pomonti, a retired architect, is found savagely murdered in his opulent villa in La Celle-Saint-Cloud, near Paris. It soon becomes clear that the man has been tortured prior to death.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.
programme.sub-title: The Disappeared Of Nancy: The Julie Martin Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Last Tango (Saada case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.
programme.sub-title: The Strange Farm: The Anaïs Guillaume Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.
programme.sub-title: A Strange Deadly Robbery: The Isabelle Mosser Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 503
programme.desc: Da Marlene var kun 19 år gammel tilbød hendes kæreste hende et par nye bryster. Marlene takkede ja, og derefter fulgte et kaotisk forløb med gener, og Malene er bange for, om noget er alvorligt galt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 806
programme.desc: Tinas mareridt startede i 2015, hvor hun får en tumor på næsen, der bliver ved med at vokse. Hun må i strålebehandling for at få den fjernet, men tumoren efterlader et hul, som skal lukkes.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 401
programme.desc: Vi møder perfektionisten Christina, der efter to kejsersnit har fået et grimt ar og en delle på maven, som hun eksperimenterer med at skjule ved at vikle maven ind i husholdningsfilm.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 903
programme.desc: Nanna har fået flere brystoperationer og korrektioner, men er nu efterladt med misformede, hårde bryster. Heidi kan grundet operationer ikke holde ud at hun selv eller andre ser hende nøgen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 301
programme.desc: Fejlslagne plastikoperationer har givet fire kvinder ar på både krop og sjæl. Vi møder Jane, som har fået ødelagt sin karriere som dildosælger af, at hun ikke længere selv har lyst til sex på grund af sine grimme bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 807
programme.desc: I 2010 tog Tina til Thailand for at få udskiftet sine brystimplantater, men operationen gik ikke som forventet, og i dag står hun tilbage med smerter der hæmmer hende på dansegulvet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 803
programme.desc: Natasja er tidligere side-9-pige og model. I 2013 fik hun skiftet implantaterne i silikonebrysterne ud, men operationen gik ikke som planlagt, og som resultat har hun nu to meget forskellige bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 512
programme.desc: Nina arbejder som show-pige, og det påvirker derfor hendes arbejde meget, når hun skal fokusere på et rutsjende implantat og en grim kavalergang.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 309
programme.desc: Vi møder Ditte, der har brugt 120.000 kr. på at få lavet sine bryster større, og som i dag står tilbage med kæmpestore, men asymmetriske bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 502
programme.desc: Lenette har tabt sig 55 kilo og føler, at hun har for meget løs hud på mave, bryster og lår. Hun finder derfor en kirurg, foretager alle tre operationer, men det går ikke som planlagt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 614
programme.desc: 24-årige Bettina har hele livet været ked af sin næse, der i folkeskolen har givet anledning til øgenavne som Pelikanen og H.C. Andersen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 603
programme.desc: For tre år siden valgte Sarah at få foretaget en brystforstørrende operation i Polen, men efter indgrebet syntes hun, brysterne lignede to kaffeposer med implantater.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 608
programme.desc: I 2011 vælger Sabina at få lavet en brystforstørrende operation. Men allerede få dage efter indgrebet opdager hun, at brysterne hænger.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Vi møder Connie, der ønskede sig naturlige bryster, men blev rådgivet af sin kirurg til at vælge de største implantater. Nu føler hun, at hun har fået lavet så store bryster, at folk tænker: ”..der kommer brysterne med Connie”

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 612
programme.desc: Efter et større vægttab får 25-årige Michele lavet en maveskindsoperation, men resultatet skuffer slemt, og Michele har fået store problemer med sin livskvalitet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 203
programme.desc: Mød Pia, der efter en brystforstørrende operation fik stafylokokker og måtte gå 6 måneder med kun ét implantat hun først fik ud, da hun fik blodforgiftning.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 610
programme.desc: Sportsglade Jeanette blev for 12 år siden inspireret af en trend i fitnesscenteret, hvor veninderne fik opereret deres bryster større. Modsat veninderne bliver hun ikke glad for sine nye store bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 403
programme.desc: Vi møder Charlotte, der har svært ved at få et forhold til en mand, fordi hun skammer sig over sine silikonebryster, og Katja, som kæmper med gamle tråde fra tidligere operationer i brysterne.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 507
programme.desc: For 10 år siden får Michelle fjernet en godartet cyste bag højre øje. Operationen medfører, at øjenlåget hænger løst nedover øjet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Mød Louise, der brugte familiens penge på en brystoperation, der endte med at blive en traumatisk oplevelse for hende.
